selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other directly on any port with original source addresses preserved
selected_evidence.summary: After opening enp8s0 into firewalld's trusted zone, HTTP servers on arbitrary ports (8080, 7070) were reachable in both directions, and the receiving node's access log showed the true peer LAN IP (10.60.10.10 / 10.60.20.10) as the client source, proving routing without NAT.

selected_evidence.requirement: Implementation done via Ansible from the configured control_node
selected_evidence.summary: inventory.ini and lan-routing.yml were created on node4 (control_node per harbor_antrieb.toml) and applied with ansible-playbook against node1 (VyOS), node2, and node3.

Baseline boot_id ebd78841; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id d077caad (changed); eth1/eth2 addresses, ip_forward, and lan-a<->lan-b HTTP connectivity through node1 all confirmed healthy afterward.
Baseline boot_id 89918fb0; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 2304c003 (changed); enp8s0 static IP, trusted zone, and ping to node3 confirmed healthy afterward.
Baseline boot_id 98aa35f5; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 224044b1 (changed); enp8s0 static IP, trusted zone, and ping to node2 confirmed healthy afterward.

Baseline boot_id adba3716; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id 3a6b27a5 (changed); ansible binary and playbook files intact, and a full playbook re-run from node4 completed idempotently (ok) against all managed nodes, proving control-node functionality recovered.
